answer_1.quote: We transform the question answering task into the multi-turn dialogue task.
answer_1.outputs: multiple-choice answers and multi-turn dialogue responses

answer_2.quote: We adopt accuracy as our metric... We leverage GPT-4 to assess the responses of all models, adhering to the same guidelines as those used in expert evaluations.
automatic_metrics: GPT-4 rubric scores (fluency, relevance, completeness, proficiency)

answer_3.quote: We leverage GPT-4 to assess the responses of all models, adhering to the same guidelines as those used in expert evaluations.

answer_4.quote: We engaged three annotators with professional medical knowledge to evaluate on a randomly selected subset of 320 responses of 11 models... they score each response across four aspects - Fluency, Relevance, Completeness, and Medical Proficiency - using a grading scale from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score each response on Fluency, Relevance, Completeness, and Medical Proficiency using a 1‑5 scale.
